cli.title: Command-line access
cli.description: Install the cockpit-chess command-line tool and manage the keys it can use.

install.title: Install or update
install.description: Paste one of these commands into a terminal. Running it again updates cockpit-chess to the latest version; <0>cockpit-chess update</0> does the same from inside the tool.
install.expiresAt: This command contains a one-time sign-in token and stops working at {{time}} (15 minutes). Don't share it.
install.nextStep: After installing, run <0>cockpit-chess login</0> and approve the request in your browser.
install.unavailableDescription: This server isn't configured to serve the command-line tool yet. Ask an administrator to set CLI_RELEASE_REPO.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For CI jobs and scripts that can't open a browser. For your own terminal, use <0>cockpit-chess login</0> instead. API keys can't be used for admin actions.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key to use cockpit-chess from CI or a script.

create.title: Create API key
create.description: Name the key after where it will be used, so you know which one to revoke later.
create.createdWarning: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it in your CI secrets or a password manager now.
create.usage: Pipe it to <0>cockpit-chess login --with-api-key</0> or set the <1>COCKPIT_CHESS_API_KEY</1> environment variable.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke API key
revokeDialog.description: Anything using this key will stop working immediately. This can't be undone.
revokeDialog.typeNameToConfirm: Type the key's name to confirm:

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: Connect your OpenRouter account to run hosted matches on this server. Their model costs are billed to your OpenRouter key, never to the server.
openrouter.unavailableDescription: This server doesn't let users connect OpenRouter yet. You can still watch every published match and play in the Local lab. An operator can turn it on (CHESS_USER_MATCHES_ENABLED).

how.title: How it works
how.pay: You pay OpenRouter directly for the tokens your matches use. This server charges nothing.
how.limit: OpenRouter creates a key just for this server, with the spend limit and expiry you pick below. You can change both on OpenRouter's consent screen.
how.safe: The key stays on the server, encrypted. It is never shown again, not even to you or to admins.
how.revoke: You can disconnect here at any time: this server deletes the key and stops your queued or running match on it. Revoking the key on OpenRouter also stops a running match, at its next request.

openrouter.limitHint: The most this key can ever spend. {{amount}} is a good start; you can raise it later on OpenRouter.
openrouter.expiryHint: After this the key stops working and you connect again. 90 days is a good default.
openrouter.connectNext: Next: OpenRouter asks you to sign in and approve the key, then sends you back here.

connectError.twoFactor: Set up two-factor authentication in Settings → Security first, then connect.

openrouter.invalidDescription: OpenRouter no longer accepts this key: it was revoked, expired or ran out. Connect again to keep running hosted matches.
openrouter.stale: OpenRouter didn't answer just now, so these numbers may be out of date.
openrouter.nextStep: Next: open the arena's Studio and create a match. It is billed to this key.
openrouter.connectOff: Connecting a key isn't available on this server right now, so this key can't be replaced here. You can still disconnect it.
openrouter.replaceHint: Connecting again replaces this key here. Revoke the old one on OpenRouter afterwards.

result.connected: OpenRouter connected. You can now create hosted matches.
result.denied: You didn't approve the key on OpenRouter, so nothing changed. Connect again when you're ready.
result.expired: The connection took too long (over 10 minutes). Start again.
result.mismatch: This sign-in doesn't match the browser or account that started connecting. Start again from this page.
result.exchange: OpenRouter didn't hand over the key. Start again; if it keeps failing, try later.
result.verify: OpenRouter gave a key that doesn't work. Start again, or check your OpenRouter account.
result.unavailable: Connecting isn't available on this server right now. Try again later.
result.disabled: This server doesn't allow connecting OpenRouter.
result.unknown: The connection didn't finish. Start again.
result.used: This connection link was already used. If Settings doesn't show your key as connected, start again.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect OpenRouter?
disconnectDialog.description: This server deletes the key and stops your queued or running match on it. Disconnect waits until the match has stopped, and tells you if it can't confirm that. The key itself keeps working on OpenRouter until you revoke it there.
disconnectDialog.revokeNote: To revoke it, open “Manage on OpenRouter” before or after disconnecting.

toast.none: OpenRouter disconnected. This server deleted the key. Revoke it on OpenRouter too.
toast.stopped: OpenRouter disconnected. Everything on this server that was using the key has stopped, and the key is deleted here. Revoke it on OpenRouter too.
toast.pending: OpenRouter disconnected and the key deleted here, but the server couldn't confirm yet that your running match stopped. Revoke the key on OpenRouter now to be sure nothing more is spent.

openrouter.unreadableDescription: This server can't open your saved key, usually because its encryption secret changed. Connect again to keep running hosted matches, or ask the operator to check CHESS_PROVIDER_KEY_SECRET.
